landing.meta_title: Chess Empire — Chess school for kids in Almaty
landing.hero_sub: Chess Empire — the championship method that helped raise a women’s world champion. 6 branches across the city, certified coaches, a free trial lesson.
landing.about_p1: Chess Empire is a network of chess clubs in Almaty. We make chess accessible and effective, using the championship method that helped raise a women’s world champion.
landing.about_p2: All our coaches are certified and trained. We have more than 10 years of teaching experience and 800+ students.
landing.about_p3: We have been running since 2018 and have grown into a network of 6 branches across the city. Our method helped raise a women’s world champion.
landing.features_sub: Our championship method and a professional approach to teaching
landing.f1_d: The same method that helped raise a women’s world champion. A proven training system with demonstrated results.
landing.f2_d: All coaches are certified and specially trained to work with children of different ages.
landing.f3_d: It’s easy to find a convenient branch near your home. We work in all districts of Almaty.
landing.f4_d: The first book on our method is a gift for every new student.
landing.f5_d: Free, included in the membership. Regular game practice to reinforce what’s been learned.
landing.f6_d: In a single lesson a child trains 12 intellectual skills: thinking, attention, memory and more.
landing.path_sub: The path from first steps to an international FIDE rating of 1400+
landing.l1_d: Rules of the game, how pieces move
landing.path_note: At every level a child not only gets better at the game but also develops thinking, attention, memory, discipline and leadership. Classes are held in groups of up to 10.
landing.branches_sub: Chess Empire operates at 6 locations in Almaty — choose the branch nearest to you
landing.b1_d: A modern branch with spacious halls for lessons and tournaments.
landing.b2_d: 71 Kabanbay Batyr St. Adult classes are also held here.
landing.b3_d: A convenient central location with good transport links.
landing.b4_d: A classic branch with a cozy atmosphere for learning.
landing.b6_d: A modern branch in a new residential complex.
landing.tour_title: Liga B and Liga C tournaments
landing.tour_p1: Our students play in tournaments every weekend at the Gagarin Park, Debut, Halyk Arena, Almaty Arena and Almaty-1 branches.
landing.tour_p2: It’s invaluable game practice that reinforces everything the child has learned in class. As they progress, children gain access to more serious tournaments.
landing.tour_strong: Up to 4 free tournaments a month are included in the membership.
landing.trainers_sub: FIDE Masters and Candidate Masters with extensive experience teaching children
landing.tr1_d: Co-founder and director of Chess Empire. Developer of the Chess Empire teaching method. Director of chess development in Kazakhstan at the Chess Federation. 2023–2024 President of the Almaty Chess Union. Over 10 years of coaching experience. Peak international FIDE rating 2121.
landing.tr2_d: FIDE Master, senior coach of Almaty, Honored Coach of the Republic of Kazakhstan, head of the Debut chess club.
landing.tr4_d: Chess coach at Chess Empire. FIDE Master (FM). Peak FIDE rating 2381. Champion of the Republic of Sakha (Yakutia). Over 7 years of teaching experience.
landing.tr5_d: Chess coach at Chess Empire. FIDE Master. Has trained more than 700 students.
landing.programs_sub: Training is built as a path through levels — from first steps to an international FIDE rating of 1400+
landing.p1_d: Rules of the game, piece moves, concentration, memorising moves. The first step into chess for the youngest.
landing.p2_d: Calculating variations, game planning, reviewing mistakes, playing in tournaments. Active growth of chess skill.
landing.p3_d: Decisions under pressure, strategy, managing emotions. Building a chess character.
landing.p4_d: Deep position analysis, playing in serious tournaments. Preparation for international competitions.
landing.p5_d: High-level play, leadership, mentoring. Training professional chess players.
landing.adults_p: Adult classes are held at the Debut branch (71 Kabanbay Batyr St.), from 19:00 to 21:00.
landing.adults_trial: The trial lesson is free; afterwards you can talk to the coach and make your decision.
landing.trial_title: Book your child a free trial lesson
landing.trial_sub: The trial lesson is free and lasts about 30 minutes. The coach will get to know your child, assess their level and give you feedback after the lesson.

landing.r1: In six months our son has changed a lot — he’s become more attentive and patient. Now he asks to go to class himself! The coach found a great approach to him.
landing.r2: Our daughter has been training for a year and earned the 4th category. We’re very happy with the method and the atmosphere. Tournaments are a special love — she can’t wait for them.
landing.r3: We tried other schools, but the approach here really is different. Our child doesn’t just play — he understands the game. I recommend it to everyone!
landing.a1: The cost depends on the branch and the chosen plan. Standard plans start at 29 500 ₸/month for 2 lessons a week of 60 minutes. Prices are slightly higher at the Gagarin Park and Debut branches. See the details in the “Prices and memberships” section.
landing.a2: Kazakh-speaking coaches work at the Debut, Zhandosov and Almaty Arena branches.
landing.a3: Private lessons are only given as a trial lesson or when preparing for major championships (10 000 ₸/hour). For beginners and continuing students we recommend the group format — it is more effective for development.
landing.a4: Classes are held twice a week for 60 minutes (90 or 120 minutes for ranked players). Groups run Mon/Wed and Tue/Thu: 9:00–18:00, Sat/Sun: 9:00–13:00. Friday is a day off.
landing.q5: Can we attend once a week?
landing.a5: No, this format isn’t offered. Once-a-week lessons don’t give the necessary results and practice. Progress requires at least 2 lessons a week.
landing.q6: How do tournaments work and when can my child take part?
landing.a6: Tournaments are held every weekend at 5 branches. A child can take part after completing the first stage of training and passing an exam with the coach. Up to 4 free tournaments a month are included in the membership.
landing.q7: Can I buy a partial membership?
landing.a7: No, the membership is purchased in full. Attendance is only possible according to the set schedule.
landing.a8: Yes, adult classes are held at the Debut branch (71 Kabanbay Batyr St.) from 19:00 to 21:00. One lesson costs 5 000 ₸. The trial lesson is free.
landing.a9: No, we don’t have that program. We work with our own Chess Empire championship method.
landing.a10: Only the trial lesson (30 minutes) is free. Training is paid — from 29 500 ₸/month. Discounts are available for large families and children with disabilities.
landing.q11: Do you create the personal account, or do we need to register ourselves?
landing.a11: The personal account is created after the first lesson together with the coach. We’ll help you register and explain how to use it.
